suggestions.suggestion: Switch GitHub Pages from the legacy 'main /' source to the Actions workflow
suggestions.why: With the legacy source the whole public repository is published, including raw JSON/CSV data files. That widens the surface of the NBA-derived content that the Terms-of-Use flag concerns.
suggestions.options: A: keep legacy source (current); B: switch to GitHub Actions so only the curated artifact is published.
suggestions.recommended_option: B — it publishes only the reviewed pages and removes the raw data files from the public surface.
suggestions.dependency: Requires a repository admin token with Pages administration rights.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a single 'as of' timestamp and data-freshness badge on every page
suggestions.why: Official sources move during a slate (injury reports every 15 minutes, tip times can change, stats pages update after games). A reader cannot currently tell how old a page is.
suggestions.options: A: keep the current per-table source stamps only; B: add one global snapshot stamp plus a per-table freshness badge.
suggestions.recommended_option: B — already implemented in this session for the canonical pages.

suggestions.suggestion: Turn the leaderboard into a scored competition with an explicit prize rule
suggestions.why: The brief asks for a leaderboard competition with rewards for the best strategies. The repository has gates and a ranking, but no reward rule, no capital base and no drawdown limit.
suggestions.options: A: keep gates only (current); B: add a paper-trading prize rule with a fixed stake and a published drawdown stop.
suggestions.recommended_option: B, once the legal and data questions (CQ pages) are answered.
suggestions.dependency: CQ legal answers; a licensed or owner-captured price source for scoring.

suggestions.suggestion: Add possession-level inputs (four factors) to the total model
suggestions.why: The total model does not beat a naive league-average baseline out of sample (RMSE 20.35 vs 19.56), so every total-based strategy rests on a model with no demonstrated skill.
suggestions.options: A: keep the total model as published with the caveat; B: add offensive/defensive ratings and pace matchup before publishing total-based strategies.
suggestions.recommended_option: B — the model is already written for it and the inputs are official NBA stats.
suggestions.dependency: Official team ratings (already captured) and player box scores.
